summary: This Wikipedia article profiles LeBron James, the American NBA player born in Akron, Ohio, covering his high school career, his first overall draft pick by the Cleveland Cavaliers in 2003, and his moves to Miami and back to Cleveland. It summarizes his awards and Finals record, including his 2016 title ending Cleveland's 52-year drought, and describes his early family background. The note also includes repeated infobox and career-highlight boilerplate that restates the same awards and team history.
one_line: Profile of LeBron James, the Akron-born NBA small forward known for his Cavaliers and Heat careers, multiple MVP awards and Finals championships.
key_facts: James played high school basketball at St. Vincent -- St. Mary High School in Akron, Ohio.
James was selected first overall in the 2003 NBA draft by the Cleveland Cavaliers.
James led Cleveland to its first Finals appearance in 2007, losing to the San Antonio Spurs.
In 2010, James left the Cavaliers for the Miami Heat in a highly publicized ESPN special titled The Decision.
James won back-to-back championships with the Miami Heat in 2012 and 2013.
In 2013, Miami won 27 consecutive games, the third longest winning streak in league history.
James returned to the Cavaliers after the 2014 season and led them to three consecutive Finals from 2015 to 2017.
James won his third championship in 2016, ending Cleveland's 52-year professional sports title drought.
James has won four NBA Most Valuable Player awards, in 2009, 2010, 2012 and 2013.
James was named NBA Rookie of the Year in 2004.
In Game 5 of the 2007 NBA Conference Finals, James scored 48 points and scored 29 of Cleveland's last 30 points.
During the 2007 NBA Finals, James averaged 22 points, 7.0 rebounds, and 6.8 assists on 35.6 percent shooting.
James was born on December 30, 1984 in Akron, Ohio to a 16-year-old mother, Gloria Marie James.
Frank Walker, a local youth football coach, introduced James to basketball when he was nine years old.
The article notes that James has never won the Defensive Player of the Year Award but has finished second in the voting twice.
